ms.promise: In this phase, we will organize the project, setup the team, create a cohort out of the mentorship hub to run this experiment, create the user journey, conduct interviews with the cohort to determine product/market fit and other feedback loops, from the interviews we will determine specific KPIs and North star metric for the product, create a business model, and plan for the implementation phase
ms.criteria:
- Mapping of players: Internal Seedstars resources organized. Mentorship hub cohort to run experiment on determined
- User Journey: Development of user journey through use of the product and the cohort through the experiment
- User Interviews: Setup and conduct interviews with determined test cohort and categorize answers into meaningful insights to find product market fit and create a minimum viable product
- North Metric Star, KPIs and Assumptions: Utilize interview feedback to create NSM for the product, define assumptions for use, and develop KPIs for product implementation measurement
- V

ms.promise:
Research output
- Identification of key products that are offering the same value proposition
- Identification of key challenges that hinder those products from scaling
- Understanding the added value for users 
- Understanding the impact of the product
- Understanding the potential product sustainability
- Synthesizing and analyzing research findings to prepare for implementation

Integration output
- A production MVP for mentors and mentees to use decentralized ID to confirm when a mentoring session has taken place and provide mutual ratings and reviews for those sessions.
- Seedstars mentor portal and related third-party systems integrated with ProofSpace -Dashboard for issuing/verifying credentials
- Workflows live for mentors and mentees in the ProofSpace App:
- Seedstars SSI OAuth: a deep link interaction from Seedstars portal to open the ProofSpace App, discover the Seedstars mentor/mentee profile and complete SSI OAuth two-factor authentication. Receive back a unique “Seedstars ID”.
- Mentor Session Confirmation: an interaction to confirm, with their assigned Seedstars ID, that a session has taken place. Receive back the counter-party validated confirmation.
- Mentor Sessio
